correctness.rationale: PASS: From group law g_i^2=(0,0,x_i y_i) in characteristic two and g_i g_j=g_j g_i iff x_i y_j=x_j y_i, the matrix S=XY is symmetric with zero diagonal (alternating). For X rank d and W=im X, admissible alternating S of image in W are precisely pulled-back alternating forms on W*, a d-dimensional space with q^(d choose 2) possibilities; each column has q^(b-d) lifts to Y. Rank-d X count is Gaussian binomial times full-rank surjections k^b->W. Central coordinates supply q^r. The d=r term dominates as b->infinity, giving the stated probability. Independent brute force of q=2 rank fibers (b,r)=(1,1),(1,2),(1,3),(2,1),(2,2) agrees with formula, including total 28 at (1,2). The finite checks alone do not prove all q,b,r.
